interception.mode: conditional fixed-progress, finite quota-clear cycle; no capture objectives, high-priority assaults or progress-triggered bosses

interception.schedule: SquadLib P21 pc34/37 and P18 pc99-101: the first cycle starts with zero delay. Draw one squad only after the delay and live+max(rawMinSquad,1)<=softM gates, without per-member softM truncation; hardcap still applies. Gate failure keeps current delay; admitted attempt resets delay if>=max, else max if now full, else adds increment. Later quota cycles restart the initial batch and default delay as a scenario rule.
interception.leaderChance: Territory P34 uses persistent elapsedSeconds, offset=floor(lerp(120,0,difficulty)); chance0 before offset+60 then lerp(.02,.15,min((elapsed-offset-60)/2940,1))*nativeMultiplier

interception.weightedSelection: Native selector filters runtime tier/cap/level/faction/tag/canEnhance, sums weights with ADDSS and subtracts each weight from roll until selected. Scene uses mapped raw rows with per-Agent live caps; native merge/countgroup/override incomplete.
